read.thesis: Q2 CY26 earnings of $12.1B and ROCE of 21.4% came on record US output and 97% refinery crude utilisation, but capex rose to $4.5B with Hess spend and this is an earnings release, not a call.

utilisation.quote: reliable crude unit capacity utilization of more than 97 percent

capex.quote: Capex in the second quarter of 2026 was higher than last year largely due to spend on legacy Hess assets
